intro.title: Build websocket reconnect manager
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a WebSocket reconnect manager to handle dropped connections automatically. You will learn how to use JavaScript's WebSocket API to establish real-time communication with a server. The core programming concept involves managing state and event handlers to detect disconnections and trigger reconnection attempts. You'll work with timers, event listeners, and conditional logic to create a resilient connection that recovers from failures. This project introduces you to building reliable network applications in JavaScript.
intro.usecase: WebSocket reconnect managers are essential in real-time applications where persistent connections are critical. In live trading dashboards, they maintain price feed updates during network fluctuations. Chat applications like Slack use them to ensure message delivery when users switch networks. Collaborative editing tools like Google Docs implement reconnection logic to sync changes after temporary disconnections. Video conferencing platforms rely on these managers to restore streams when internet connectivity drops briefly.
